subject: Re: packaging request + pilot discount structure for VentureX
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@venturex.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Dave Patel <dpatel@venturex.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging question + pilot ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and cost projections looked promising. We're preparing an internal pilot brief and I wanted to confirm a couple of packaging items before we finalize our request to procurement: 

- Goal: 100k tokens/day average, with bursts to 350k/day for short windows (clinical triage use case)
- Ask: Can Redwood provide a pilot package with a 40% discount off list for a 12-month pilot, plus an N+1 support SLA for critical windows?

Procurement will need a formal price sheet and SOW. If there's flexibility on term or performance safeguards that would make a 40% concession more acceptable on your side, tell me and we can try to adapt the internal ask.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Product, VentureX AI
elena.torres@venturex.ai
+1 415-555-0182
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@venturex.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question + pilot ask

Elena — really glad the demo helped. Short answer: we can get you a pilot that meets the usage pattern, but the 40% off list for 12 months is outside standard delegated authority.

I'm attaching a pricing sheet and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review (see attachments). To be clear on what I can push internally:
- We can offer a structured pilot discount but it needs either a shorter minimum guarantee (we're thinking 9 months) or performance milestones tied to the discount (e.g., uptime and call volume thresholds).
- For a 12-month commitment at 40% off we'd need VP-level commercial approval — I'm escalating that now.

Next steps: I will loop in our Sales Lead (Marcus) and VP Finance (Marissa) for signoff. If VentureX is open to a 9-month firm period + a mid-pilot performance review, I can likely get a faster approval. Otherwise I'll route for exec signoff and get back to you with the final concession and any conditional terms.

Attached: VentureX_PRICING_SHEET_v3.xlsx (redacted cost bands), VentureX_SOW_draft_v1.pdf

Would you be open to a 9-month firm period with an option to extend to 12 months at the same rates if thresholds are met?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Packaging question + pilot ask — internal clearance request

Jasmine — forwarding Elena's ask. Quick internal note for Marissa: VentureX is asking for 40% off list for a 12-month pilot at the token volumes shown. Preliminary margin check: at their projected average and current quantization profile, our unit economics show ~28% GP at list; a 40% concession would push to sub-5% GP unless we attach constraints (shorter guaranteed term, usage floors, or strict CVR-based milestone release of the discount).

My recommendation: approve up to 25% off list but require a 9-month minimum and a mid-pilot usage review with a clawback clause if volumes drop >25% of the forecast. Also require standard data handling addendum and that VPC/private routing is not included in pilot price.

If Marissa gives verbal okay I can finalize a commercial memo for VP/CFO signoff.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sales Lead, Enterprise Accounts
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging question + pilot ask — internal clearance request

Thanks for the context. A couple points before we commit any concession: 

1) I can approve a concession up to 25% off list for the pilot, but with explicit constraints: 9-month firm term, a guaranteed minimum monthly usage floor (70% of the forecast average), and a mid-point performance review that can trigger a reprice if the floor is missed.

2) Any payments must be pre-funded for the first two billing periods when the concession exceeds 20% (finance risk mitigation).

3) We need legal to add a clawback clause in the SOW and a plain-language schedule to the pricing sheet that shows both list and concessioned rates and what triggers reversion to list.

If you accept the above, I will sign off and Marissa approves routing the DocuSign to the customer. I pasted a DocuSign link below for the SOW once commercial is finalized.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/signon/ABCD-VENTUREX-2026

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@venturex.ai>
Cc: Dave Patel <dpatel@venturex.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved pilot concession — Redwood x VentureX (next steps)

Elena — good news: finance has approved a concession with conditions. Summary of the approved offer below (final details will be in the SOW):

- Concession: 25% off list rates for pilot usage bands
- Term: 9 months firm, option to extend to 12 months if mid-pilot thresholds are met
- Usage floor: guaranteed minimum of 70% of forecasted average monthly tokens; if usage drops below the floor for two consecutive months, pricing reverts to list (clawback applies)
- Billing: first two billing periods to be prepaid if concession >20%
- Exclusions: private VPC deployment and premium N+1 critical-window SLA are not included in the pilot price and can be added as a paid addon

Attached are the updated pricing sheet and a draft SOW reflecting the constraints. Please review — if this looks acceptable I'll route the SOW to DocuSign (link below) for signature and we can target a Dec 1 start.

Attachments: VentureX_PRICING_SHEET_v3.xlsx, VentureX_SOW_draft_v1.pdf
DocuSign (pre-fill): https://docusign.com/link/signon/ABCD-VENTUREX-2026
